Details: The test `testGenerateURLFragment` checks whether HTML entities such as `"` are correctly escaped to their corresponding character by the `StandardToolTipTagFragmentGenerator.generateToolTipFragment` method. Consequently, un-escaped strings are being returned, which leads to the error demonstrated by the test.

The failing test exercised the method `createArchiveInputStream(java.io.InputStream)` in the class `org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.ArchiveStreamFactory`.

The test case is trying to create an archive input stream from a non-archive input (an AIFF audio file). The expected behavior is that the method throws an `ArchiveException` indicating that no suitable archiver was found. However, the method ended up creating an input stream without throwing an exception, triggering the test failure.

Next, I will check the implementation of the method `createArchiveInputStream(java.io.InputStream)` in the class `org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.ArchiveStreamFactory` to understand why this happened.
